text.en:
Section one of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred and sixty-four, as amended by
Commonwealth Act Numbered Five hundred and twenty-four, is further amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. All the unpaid real property taxes due on any real property forfeited to the provincial or city
government on or prior to January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-nine, and all penalties that have become
due thereon and remaining unpaid are remitted, if fifty per centum of the tax corresponding to the year
nineteen hundred and thirty-eight, and the entire tax corresponding to the year nineteen hundred and
thirty-nine had b?en paid on or before June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and forty."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 5, 1941.
